parts.glance:
Tracking camera from Intel with two global-shutter fisheye cameras and a Bosch BMI055 IMU, solved here on its own IMU from one recording of our VI-Rig.

Reprojection median0.16 px
cam0–cam1 baseline63.8 mm
cam0 td−8.00 ms
cam0 lever arm14.7 mm

Reprojection is how far, in pixels, the detected corners lie from where the solve puts them. td is the camera–IMU time offset, and the lever arm is the camera–IMU position offset.

One recording, with no independent reference on this page. These values show what MVIS solved, not how close they are to the truth.

parts.limits:
• One recording, with no independent reference on this page. These values show what MVIS solved, not how close they are to the truth.
  • The T265 gyro-to-accel offset isn't a pure time shift. We measured about −6.8 ms at 2–4 Hz and −1.2 ms at 30–40 Hz, so a single t_ga is a compromise that depends on the motion.
parts.run: • Fisheye stereo plus the T265's own IMU, camera intrinsics free, t_ga estimated, and the shape of the calibration board estimated, since the VI-Rig board isn't perfectly flat (about 4.5 mm peak to peak; see Board shape). Solved 2026-11-12.
